description: T-5123 (SPEC-0039 U1; T-2851's whole-line shapes): a whole-column range under delete_column D, the last column of the range: does S!B:D shrink to S!B:C (sum 6)? S!A2:F2 hold 1,2,4,8,16,32 (so the sum names the columns read) and S!H4 holds =SUM(B:D), a whole-column range on its own sheet in a cell the delete moves. Sheet F holds A1 =SUM(S!B:D), A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =SUM(S!$B:$D), A4 FORMULATEXT(A3), A5 =SUM(S!C:C) (one whole column), A6 FORMULATEXT(A5), A7 =S!H4 and A8 =FORMULATEXT(S!H4) (the references follow the moved cell).
